DealDamageWithHero_MoW_description: Deploy {[HERO_NAME]} in any game mode that supports Machines of War to do so.
DealDamageWithHero_description: Deploy {[HERO_NAME]} in any game mode to do so. There might also be an event running in which you can play {[HERO_NAME]} even without owning it.
DealDamage_description: You can do this in any game mode and with any type of attack or ability.
HealHealth_description: The <style="Living_Metal">Living Metal</style> trait of the <style="Faction_Necrons">Necrons</style> automatically restores <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> each turn.
PlayBattlesInGameMode_description: You can start these in the battle menu screen.
RaidBattles_description: You can <style="Resource_Raids">raid</style> any Campaign battles for which you have obtained all three <style="Medals">medals</style>. Doing so gives you the raid rewards instantly without the need to play the battle again.
SlayEnemiesOfFaction_TimedQuest_descript: Note: You can fight them in Onslaught and Guild Raids once you unlock them at Power levels 4 and 5
SlayEnemiesOfFaction_Tyranids_descriptio: Note: You can fight them in Onslaught and Guild Raids once you unlock them at Power levels 4 and 5. You can also occasionally find them in certain events.
SlayEnemiesOfFaction_description: The start screens of all game modes will show you which kind of enemies you will face in battle.
SlayEnemiesWithFactionTrait_description: Deploy {[FACTION_TRAIT]} <style="Character">Characters</style> to do so. There might also be an event running in which you can play {[FACTION_TRAIT]} Characters even without owning them.
SlayEnemiesWithMeleeAttacks_description: Your <style="Unit">units</style> use melee attacks when they are in a hex adjacent to an enemy unit. Active abilities used to defeat enemy <style="Unit">units</style> in adjacent hexes also count.
SlayEnemiesWithRangedAttacks_description: Your <style="Unit">unit's</style> attacks count as ranged when they use a ranged attack active ability, or when they perform a normal attack and don't have any enemy <style="Unit">units</style> in hexes adjacent to them. Not all <style="Character">Characters</style> have ranged attacks.
UseAbilityWithFactionTrait_description: Use of the <style="Healer">Heal</style> or <style="Mechanic">Repair</style> actions does not count.
UseAbilityWithHero_MoW_description:
Deploy {[HERO_NAME]} in any game mode that supports Machines of War to do so. 
Use of the <style="Healer">Heal</style> or <style="Mechanic">Repair</style> actions does not count.
UseAbilityWithHero_description:
Deploy {[HERO_NAME]} in any battle to do so. There might also be an event running in which you can play {[HERO_NAME]} even without owning it. 
Use of the <style="Healer">Heal</style> or <style="Mechanic">Repair</style> actions does not count.
UseAbility_description: Use of the <style="Healer">Heal</style> or <style="Mechanic">Repair</style> actions does not count.
WinBattlesWithFactionTraitLineup_descrip: 3-<style="Character">Character</style> lineups are also eligible for this Mission.
WinBattlesWithoutUsingSummons_descriptio: Refrain from deploying <style="Character">Characters</style> with such an ability (e.g. <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Archimatos</style>).
WinCampaignBattles_description: Winning or <style="Resource_Raids">raiding</style> already won battles also counts.
WinLightningVictories_description: It can be a battle you had won before. Lightning Victories give you additional <style="Resource_Gold">Coins</style>.
